title: Simulating Strategic Reasoning: A Digital Twin Approach to AI Advisors in Decision-Making

contributions.purpose: 提出构建战略顾问数字孪生的方法学
contributions.mechanism: 结合两轮半结构化访谈知识捕获 + 多 LLM prompting + RAG(无微调),对单一资深战略家(Participant A)建孪生
contributions.evaluation: 42 道验证题(简单/复杂),leakage control(验证题排除出 RAG 索引);16 个 LLM 交叉测试
contributions.domain: AI 顾问 / 数字孪生 / 战略决策
contributions.source_quote: a methodology for constructing digital twins of strategic advisors by combining interview-based knowledge capture with large language model (LLM) prompting techniques

contributions.purpose: 跨模型评测孪生保真度,揭示简单/复杂任务鸿沟
contributions.mechanism: 16 模型对 A 的选项匹配打分(rubric 0/0.5/0.66/1),按难度分层
contributions.evaluation: 总体保真约 50%(Claude Opus 4.1/Gemini 2.5 Pro 50.19%,Grok 4 仅 34.71%);简单题最高 88.9%(ChatGPT5-thinking),复杂题平均约 40%、Level-4 多 <30%(Grok 4 27%)
contributions.source_quote: fidelity in digital twins is uneven, with models excelling at surface-level decision replication but struggling with deeper reasoning

contributions.purpose: 以负责任 AI 视角讨论表征/信任/漂移风险
contributions.mechanism: 语义相似度(TF-IDF+cosine 映射 0-10)辅助分析,含文化背景因素
contributions.evaluation: 中文 LLM(DeepSeek/Ernie/Doubao)语义相似度高于均值,DeepSeek 复杂 L4 更高——归因文化/语言邻近
contributions.source_quote: it advanced the discussion of responsible AI by identifying the risks of misrepresentation, over-reliance, and model drift in advisory applications

self_declared_provenance.quote: Sprint et al. [2024], for example, combined an LLM with interview transcripts to simulate over 1,000 individuals; the resulting agents replicated their respective persons' survey responses with about 85% of the accuracy... Our primary contribution is methodological and evaluative: a transparent, replicable pipeline

notes: 自声明 3 条贡献(intro+conclusion 一致)。核心负结果:复杂多选推理保真度骤降——简单题 78-89% vs 复杂题约 40%、Level-4 多 <30%,总体仅约 50%('AI can echo the voice but not yet the logic')。n=1 参与者、42 题,作者自认不可泛化。数据红旗:(1)破坏双盲——PDF 署真实作者 Dinithi N. Jayasekara、Cathy Qian Huang 及 SUTD 新加坡完整地址/邮箱,并列'ChatGPT 5'为第一作者,匿名会议未匿名;Participant A 虽匿名但细节丰富(SUTD 设计AI大学领导、Singlish 口音)有再识别风险。(2)附录 A.1 泄露真实 OpenAI file-ID(file-BsUDNJc8h5EEqcGADCcCow 等 9 个)。(3)checklist Q6[Yes]称'how the models were trained'——实际无训练,仅 RAG+prompt,措辞不准。(4)Q7 统计显著性[No](preliminary 无 error bar)、Q5 open code[No](数据仅按需)。语义相似度为纯词汇级 TF-IDF(作者自认不捕深层语义)。AI 披露:hypothesis[B]、experiments/analysis[C]、writing[D](ChatGPT5 Deep Research 约 95% 写作),并用 Custom GPT(GPT-5)做 AI reviewer 自评迭代——循环自证流程但作者透明披露。
